allow: PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3001,3002,5173 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalPort, OwningProcess | ForEach-Object { $p = \(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\).ProcessName; "Port $\($_.LocalPort\) -> PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) \($p\)" })

PowerShell(Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3001 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $p=Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; "3001 -> PID $\($_.OwningProcess\) \($\($p.ProcessName\)\) started $\($p.StartTime\)" })
